title: Recover Non-Recoverable Operator Station Motor Fault Using MCP_Dual (F3) Manual Jog, Reset, and Cycle Start
summary: When a non-recoverable operator station motor fault (e.g., motor overload) cannot be recovered in software, use the operator station HMI MCP_Dual screen (F3) to stop the cycle, enter manual jog mode, clear any axis faults with RESET, jog the correct axes to reposition the tote on/near the robot, then return to automatic mode and press CYCLE START to release the grippers and command the robot to the hospital station. After the robot leaves the tipper, press RESET.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when the operator station has a non-recoverable motor fault (example given: motor overload) and the station needs to be manually reset so the tote can be repositioned and the robot can be commanded to the hospital station.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Execute the MCP_Dual (F3) manual recovery sequence (CYCLE STOP, JOG, RESET, axis jogging, AUTO, CYCLE START, and final RESET).
access_or_tools_needed: Operator access to the operator station HMI
MCP_Dual screen (F3) controls: CYCLE STOP, JOG, RESET, AUTO, CYCLE START, and axis jog controls for Z1, Z2, A1, A2

system_preconditions: A non-recoverable operator station motor fault is present that requires manual reset (example: motor overload).
Operator station HMI is able to navigate to the MCP_Dual screen (F3).

visual_references.description: MCP_Dual (F3) screen showing Manual Mode Fault indicator, RESET button, and axis status indicators (Z1, Z2, A2, A1) used for non-recoverable operator station motor fault recovery.
MCP_Dual (F3) screen in manual jog mode showing JOG, Manual Mode status, axis fault indicators, and RESET button.
MCP_Dual (F3) screen showing AUTO and CYCLE START sequence context (grippers release and robot commanded to hospital station).

steps.title: Navigate to MCP_Dual (F3) on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Open the manual recovery interface for non-recoverable operator station motor faults.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "MCP_Dual" screen (F3).
steps.expected_result: The MCP_Dual (F3) screen is displayed with the Manual Mode/Fault area and the visible controls used for recovery (including RESET and cycle controls).
steps.healthy_condition: MCP_Dual (F3) is visible and shows the Manual Mode Fault area and axis status indicators (Z1, Z2, A2, A1).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reach the MCP_Dual (F3) screen or the required controls (RESET / cycle controls) are not available.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "MCP_Dual" screen (F3).

steps.title: Stop the tipping cycle with CYCLE STOP
steps.purpose: Halt the tipping cycle before switching to manual jog and resetting faults.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the tipping cycle.
steps.expected_result: The tipping cycle is stopped (cycle is halted) on the MCP_Dual (F3) screen.
steps.healthy_condition: CYCLE STOP has been pressed and the cycle is in a stopped state.
steps.failure_condition: The cycle does not stop after pressing CYCLE STOP.

actions.label: Stop cycle
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the tipping cycle.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the tipping cycle.

steps.title: Enter manual jog mode with JOG
steps.purpose: Enable manual axis jogging to reposition the tote and clear faults.
steps.instruction: Press JOG to enter manual jog mode.
steps.expected_result: Manual jog mode is active (Manual Mode indicator/status is shown) on MCP_Dual (F3).
steps.healthy_condition: Manual Mode is indicated and the manual jog controls are available.
steps.failure_condition: Manual jog mode does not activate after pressing JOG.

actions.label: Enter manual jog
actions.exact_action: Press JOG to enter manual jog mode.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press JOG to enter manual jog mode.

steps.title: Clear any axis faults with RESET
steps.purpose: Remove axis fault indications so manual jogging and recovery can proceed.
steps.instruction: If any of the axes show a fault, press RESET to clear the fault.
steps.expected_result: Axis fault indicators clear after pressing RESET (no longer indicated on the affected axis/axes).
steps.healthy_condition: No axis fault indicators remain visible on MCP_Dual (F3) after RESET.
steps.failure_condition: Axis fault indicators remain visible after pressing RESET while in manual jog mode.

actions.label: Reset axis faults
actions.exact_action: press RESET to clear the fault

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot clear an axis fault using RESET while in manual jog mode (fault remains indicated on one or more axes).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If any of the axes show a fault, press RESET to clear the fault.

steps.title: Jog axes to reposition the tote on/near the robot
steps.purpose: Place the tote so the robot can be commanded to the hospital station.
steps.instruction: If the tote is lifted off the robot, jog either the Z-axis or A-axis, or both, to position the tote on or nearly on the robot. Use A1 and Z1 for the left axis; use A2 and Z2 for the right tipper.
steps.expected_result: The tote is positioned on or nearly on the robot by jogging the correct axis controls (left: A1/Z1, right: A2/Z2).
steps.healthy_condition: Tote is positioned on/near the robot using the correct left/right axis controls (A1/Z1 for left; A2/Z2 for right).
steps.failure_condition: Tote cannot be positioned on/near the robot using the available axis jog controls for the correct side.

actions.label: Jog left tipper axes (if needed)
actions.exact_action: Use A1 and Z1 for the left axis

actions.label: Jog right tipper axes (if needed)
actions.exact_action: use A2 and Z2 for the right tipper

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If the tote is lifted off the robot, jog either the Z-axis or A-axis, or both, to position the tote on or nearly on the robot. NOTE: Use A1 and Z1 for the left axis; use A2 and Z2 for the right tipper.

steps.title: Return to automatic mode with AUTO
steps.purpose: Switch from manual jog mode back to automatic mode to start the recovery cycle.
steps.instruction: Press AUTO to enter automatic mode.
steps.expected_result: Automatic mode is active (Manual Mode indicator clears/changes) on MCP_Dual (F3).
steps.healthy_condition: AUTO mode is entered and the screen reflects automatic mode context.
steps.failure_condition: AUTO does not switch the system into automatic mode.

actions.label: Enter auto
actions.exact_action: Press AUTO to enter automatic mode.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press AUTO to enter automatic mode.

steps.title: Start cycle with CYCLE START to release grippers and command hospital
steps.purpose: Release the grippers and command the robot to the hospital station after tote positioning and reset.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE START. The grippers will release and the robot will be commanded to go to the hospital station.
steps.expected_result: Grippers release and the robot is commanded to go to the hospital station.
steps.healthy_condition: After pressing CYCLE START, grippers release and robot proceeds toward the hospital station.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing CYCLE START does not result in gripper release and a command for the robot to go to the hospital station.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if pressing CYCLE START does not result in gripper release and a command for the robot to go to the hospital station.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press CYCLE START. The grippers will release and the robot will be commanded to go to the hospital station.

steps.title: After robot leaves tipper, press RESET
steps.purpose: Complete the recovery sequence after the robot departs the tipper area.
steps.instruction: After the robot has left the tipper, press RESET.
steps.expected_result: RESET is pressed after robot departure from the tipper, completing the recovery sequence.
steps.healthy_condition: Robot has left the tipper and RESET is pressed as the final action in the sequence.
steps.failure_condition: RESET is pressed before the robot has left the tipper, or the sequence cannot be completed as instructed.

actions.label: Final reset
actions.exact_action: After the robot has left the tipper, press RESET.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: After the robot has left the tipper, press RESET.

success_criteria: Axis faults are cleared after pressing RESET in manual jog mode.
Tote is positioned on or nearly on the robot using the correct axes (A1/Z1 for left; A2/Z2 for right).
After pressing AUTO then CYCLE START, grippers release and the robot is commanded to go to the hospital station.
After the robot has left the tipper, pressing RESET completes the recovery sequence.
healthy_conditions: Manual jog mode is active when jogging is required.
Axis fault indicators clear after RESET.
AUTO mode is entered before CYCLE START.
Grippers release and robot proceeds to the hospital station after CYCLE START.
failure_conditions: Axis fault indicators remain after pressing RESET in manual jog mode.
CYCLE START does not cause gripper release and does not command the robot to the hospital station.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot clear an axis fault using RESET while in manual jog mode, stop and escalate.
If pressing CYCLE START does not result in gripper release and a command for the robot to go to the hospital station, stop and escalate.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Navigate to MCP_Dual (F3), press CYCLE STOP, then press JOG to enter manual jog mode; to reset the fault, press RESET.
If any axes show a fault, press RESET to clear; if tote is lifted off the robot, jog Z or A axes to position the tote; use A1/Z1 for the left axis and A2/Z2 for the right tipper.
Press AUTO to enter automatic mode; press CYCLE START—grippers release and robot is commanded to go to the hospital station; after the robot has left the tipper, press RESET.
